title: Final call (strip 2, Warschau)
idea: Het weerzien en het afscheid van strip 2 als echte korte film: de personages bewegen, je hoort de wekker, haar stem, de luchthaven.
send: Naar je lief als jullie ook op afstand wonen: zo voelt dat afscheid.
style: Hand-drawn comic illustration in exactly the style of the reference pages: clean ink outlines, soft painterly flat colors, warm natural light, same faces and proportions. Characters: the man has long curly brown hair, a full brown beard, black tank top, khaki cargo shorts and white sneakers; the woman has long straight blonde hair. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, captions, speech balloons or readable signs anywhere in the image.

shots.frame: Vertical 9:16 recomposition of the first reference panel: an underground metro platform in Warsaw, the train with open doors on the left, the blonde woman (black puff-sleeve top, olive green skirt, small backpack) has just stepped off and smiles; in the foreground on the right the bearded man waits, grinning, holding a big bouquet of dark red roses.
shots.motion: Hand-drawn 2D comic animation, keep the drawing style. The woman walks quickly toward the man, her smile getting bigger; he lifts the roses a little. Slow camera push-in. Sound: underground metro ambience, train doors hissing shut, footsteps echoing. No dialogue, no music.

shots.frame: Vertical 9:16 recomposition of the second reference panel: early morning, cool blue light in a small apartment bedroom; the bearded man and the blonde woman asleep together under a white duvet; an old-fashioned twin-bell alarm clock on the nightstand in the foreground.
shots.motion: Hand-drawn 2D comic animation, keep the drawing style. The alarm clock rings and rattles on the nightstand; the man groans and blindly reaches out an arm toward it without opening his eyes; the woman pulls the duvet over her head. Sound: loud old-fashioned alarm clock bell, sheets rustling, a sleepy groan. No speech, no music.

shots.frame: Vertical 9:16 recomposition of the third reference panel: at the apartment door in soft morning light, the bearded man wearing a big hiking backpack holds the sleepy blonde woman in a loose grey t-shirt; her head rests on his chest, eyes closed.
shots.motion: Hand-drawn 2D comic animation, keep the drawing style. They hold each other tight and sway slightly. Without lifting her head she murmurs softly and sleepily in English: "One more minute...". He smiles and kisses the top of her head. Sound: quiet room tone. Only that one spoken line, no other speech, no music.

shots.frame: Vertical 9:16 recomposition of the fourth reference panel: a bright airport terminal, the bearded man sprinting with his backpack in one hand, hair flying, travelers with rolling suitcases around him.
shots.motion: Hand-drawn 2D comic animation, keep the drawing style. He sprints toward the camera, weaving past travelers; the camera tracks backward with him. Sound: fast footsteps on tiles, rolling suitcases, a distant airport announcement chime. No speech, no music.

shots.frame: Vertical 9:16 recomposition of the fifth reference panel: an airport boarding gate with glass doors and a blank sign above them, a friendly gate agent in a navy uniform behind the desk on the left, the bearded man bursting through the doors at full speed.
shots.motion: Hand-drawn 2D comic animation, keep the drawing style. He skids to a stop at the desk, out of breath, and holds up his phone; the gate agent smiles and waves him through. Sound: an airport PA voice saying "Final call", heavy panting, a short scanner beep. No other speech, no music.

shots.frame: Vertical 9:16 recomposition of the sixth reference panel: a window seat in an airplane, warm golden sunrise light through the oval window, the bearded man smiling softly at his phone, a duffel bag in the open overhead bin.
shots.motion: Hand-drawn 2D comic animation, keep the drawing style. He reads a message on his phone, smiles, types a short reply, then leans his head back and closes his eyes with a content sigh as the sunlight moves across his face. Sound: airplane cabin hum, soft phone tapping. No speech, no music.
